Commons Map › Organizations
This is an organization-level directory only — every row is an organization or a public initiative, never an individual. No staff names, no personal emails, and no phone numbers are ever shown here, even on rows where this project’s own outreach records carry them — this page renders a name, a category, a subcategory, a ward, and a public website link, nothing else. That is a standing privacy rule for this project, not a per-row editorial choice.

The Organization Directory

2,863 verified organizations across Toronto, the GTA, and Ontario — advocacy groups, cultural and diaspora associations, business improvement areas, unions, campuses, sports clubs, credit unions, neighbourhood associations, and more — each one already doing the work this city runs on. Find your own organization, find your ward’s slice of the map, or find the door into a movement you didn’t know had a name.

Built mechanically from this project’s own outreach register: every organization on this page was checked against a live web presence and marked verified before being included here; rows that turned out to be unreachable, merged, held, or otherwise unresolved are left off rather than shown as if they were current. Only descriptive fields render — never an internal outreach note, a contact person, or any judgment about an organization’s value to this project. See a row that’s wrong, out of date, or missing? Tell us on the Harvest — every correction is read.

Optional filters — on top of the full list below. Every organization stays in this page’s HTML no matter what you pick here; the filters only show or hide rows already on the page, so search engines and no-JavaScript readers still see the whole list. 2,586 of 2,863 organizations here have a plain-language doorway to filter by; the other 277 — mostly companies, university departments, and pieces of venue infrastructure rather than a room a resident can walk into — stay listed but won’t match a doorway filter. Want the guided version of this same question? Try Find Your People.
